scope: One future model-free verification invocation: first-clock bootstrap, original-file leases, bounded output sink and source-bound data-only checkers. This is not permission to repeat or repair the old timed-out gate.

required_successor_interfaces: Continue a trusted original bootstrap owner; do not create a new start from the first post-import clock call
Adopt the same live original-lease registry and hash-bound early source captures
Reserve ownership slots before native file open and register raw returns before identity work
Retain raw read outcomes before copying bytes or hashing
Implement real versioned checker ports; synthetic checker passes grant no real eligibility

start_sequence: The frozen entry script imports only the clock prerequisite time and immediately captures time.monotonic() as its first application action
No engine/helper/source reads, hashing, import validation, authority construction or output preflight precedes that origin
All further standard-library imports, minimal file-only bindings, pure invocation/path checks and output reservation are charged to that origin
Reserve a new fixed output namespace and its bounded journal before inspecting original source/evidence bytes
Freshly lease/hash/capture the bounded entry decision and finite helper sources; compile only the exact captured hash-matching helper bytes
Transfer an owner-local BootstrapHandoff into the engine continuation without replacing origin, deadlines, output reservation, journal, leases or observations
clock_and_bootstrap.clock_scope_limit: Python/interpreter startup before the first entry action is outside this source clock and is disclosed; no whole-process preemption guarantee is claimed.

not_accepted: numeric started supplied by archive or CLI
a second owner or cross-run origin
origin.trust_limit: Frozen source-bound bootstrap is the trust boundary; owner nonces prevent accidental/serialized reuse, not hostile Python introspection.

contains: fresh digests and bounded immutable captured bytes
fixed role claims and source bindings
bootstrap_handoff.acceptance: The engine checks exact source-bound handoff type, invocation identity, one-time claim, original deadlines, gate order and all early records. It completes the full exact admission/hash graph before minting the hashes gate.
bootstrap_handoff.early_records: Owner-local known return/digest/capture records tied to still-live original leases; not serialized already_verified flags, reusable receipts or exemptions from source/role checks.
bootstrap_handoff.late_handoff: If work time is already exhausted after imports/source checks, no new validation or original reads begin. Only allowed cleanup/publication under the unchanged hard deadline remains.

fixed_authority_and_source_loading.entry: One frozen interpreter command with -I -B, fixed entry path, fixed output key and exactly one externally bound root-decision size/hash pin for its literal fixed path. No arbitrary input roots, plugins, discovery loops or start-time argument.
fixed_authority_and_source_loading.trust_anchor: The separately reviewed root invocation pins the entry code and decision size/hash after source/protocol freeze. The entry reads that decision from its fixed path under the owner clock and compares exact bytes/hash. Expected pins are claims until fresh originals match; a decision ready flag is never a gate.
fixed_authority_and_source_loading.acyclic_binding: Entry code does not embed its own or a future decision hash. The external root decision pins entry, engine, adapters, checkers, authority and protocol after they freeze. Protocol/static manifests exclude their own hashes; dynamic/owner leaves are separately enumerated. No recursive ancestor collection.
fixed_authority_and_source_loading.bootstrap_exception: Minimal inline clock/output/file-ownership code and approved interpreter/stdlib context are the explicit source trust base needed to inspect helper sources. Their later fresh source checks are under the same owner clock; this does not authenticate against a malicious Python process or OS.
fixed_authority_and_source_loading.original_role_roster: One finite reviewed exact path/size/hash/role roster plus separately enumerated owner/archive leaves. Preserve exact static/dynamic/CPU/three ordered model/pack roles and canonical collision rules; no general large-file exception.
fixed_authority_and_source_loading.source_loading: Known helper sources are read once through original-path leases, hashed/captured, and compiled from those same bytes in a fixed dependency order. A finite module map prevents source loader fallback, package discovery and reopening helper paths. No linecache/inspect/traceback source reads in bounded error formatting.
fixed_authority_and_source_loading.bootstrap_sources: Initial literal bootstrap/decision source leaves receive the same final exact role/admission/hash checks as the rest of the roster. Their early live records are adopted, not rehashed through a second pass or accepted by serialized cache authority.
fixed_authority_and_source_loading.profile_binding: The new Unicode profile is a future separate versioned contract. Its draft is not sufficient authority to create a runtime roster, pack or protocol.

file_only_port.construction: New minimal file-only typed bindings under the original clock; do not instantiate sdk.Kernel32 or import an executable launch helper.
file_only_port.load_context: Use the existing approved canonical System32 kernel32 load convention and typed declarations. Platform/stdlib loading is disclosed; no model, target DLL, Job, process, registry or global enumeration APIs are added.
file_only_port.open_flags: GENERIC_READ=0x80000000; FILE_SHARE_READ=1 only; OPEN_EXISTING=3; FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT|FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL=0x00200000|0x80; no write/delete sharing
ownership_slot: Preallocate the owner lease slot and bounded call/error/query storage before dispatch; append its reservation before CreateFileW
Store the raw returned handle and observed-return state in that existing slot immediately, before identity queries, int conversions, dictionaries, clocks, logging or other allocations
Normalize null/zero/INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE as known no-handle failures in the source-bound platform port; malformed/unreturned outcomes remain unknown
Only an explicitly acknowledged valid owned slot can become the engine's lease; never infer ownership from a foreign/malformed object
If open succeeds but a later identity check fails or times out, that slot remains owned and closes once under the same hard deadline
file_only_port.two_phase_interface: acquire_original(preallocated_owner_slot, admitted_descriptor) records ownership first; inspect_original(slot, descriptor) separately queries identity/attributes/path/size. The old single read_lease wrapper is not reused as-is.
identity: Pure canonical role/path admission precedes filesystem inspection; build a bounded owner-local unique ancestor index from exact approved paths
Check admitted ancestry for reparse spellings under the owner clock without opening any reported image path
Use the same owned file handle for FileAttributeTagInfo, bounded final DOS path and exact size; reject directory/reparse/final-path mismatch/truncation/failure
Retain raw query return flags/lengths before post-call clock or decoding; keep preallocated buffers available for late/partial evidence
Fresh hash and byte capture use this same original handle; do not copy a payload or reopen for a final hash pass
file_only_port.identity_scope: Original path, returned attributes/path/size and fresh leased bytes under ordinary platform trust. No universal filesystem authentication, hostile-race proof, inferred-image validation or new OS diagnostic is claimed.
read: One reusable preallocated 65536-byte buffer and output-count cell; no asynchronous readers
Reserve each local read attempt and mark pending before ReadFile; keep only bounded aggregate per-file read records in the durable journal
Immediately retain success/return/defined count and increment known-returned bytes in the owner slot before bytes slicing, memoryview allocation, clock, journal or digest work
Failed returned counts remain undefined even if the raw count cell is nonzero; an unreturned call retains an unknown tail
After post-return deadline checks, update hash/capture and their separate byte counts. Late known bytes remain observed but are not newly hashed after work expiry
No retry/reset/second original pass; any exhausted read/call/byte cap prevents completion
file_only_port.read_caps_proposal: Freeze per-file attempt caps from the exact admitted size: ceil(bytes/65536)+16 short-read headroom, with a separately derived finite aggregate. Every short read is retained; headroom exhaustion is explicit incomplete I/O, never an automatic retry or cap increase. Root review is required before adopting this prospective file-only cap.
file_only_port.close: One owner registry controls every handle. Reserve once before CloseHandle, retain returned success/known failure/unknown before clock/logging, never retry an uncertain close. No adapter destructor/context manager/internal validation error path closes an original behind the registry.
file_only_port.late: No new identity/read/check/cleanup API dispatch after hard expiry; retain late returns and incomplete states. Blocking calls may return late, so this is cooperative accounting, not OS preemption.

captured_context.retained_live_leases: All original input leases, including early source/authority leaves, stay live until archive/journal/resource/core/cross-universe checks finish.
indexes: profile source case and counter schemas
captured_context.index_limit: Indexes replace repeated metadata reconstruction only; they never weaken exact per-row, role, source, cap, missingness or closure checks.
captured_context.copy_rule: Captured bytes are the freshly hashed original bytes from the same handle. No checker reopens a path; in-memory checksums/decoding are allowed and do not create another original hash pass.

real_checker_ports.requirements: Exact root/protocol/authority/build/source bindings; finite relative locator grammar; receipt and terminal-seal output maps; all bytes/hashes from context; exact conditional file universe; missing seal/incomplete return and every authoritative failure marker veto positive eligibility.
real_checker_ports.universe: At most two bounded scans of the exact terminated run root, before inspection and before work completion, depth<=4 and entries<=64. Reject reparse/unknown entries before opening them. Only predeclared artifact files enter the original roster. No reported-path or global scan.
real_checker_ports.negative: A legitimate failed archived run may be completely verified as negative; failure status is not silently ignored and the strict success gate never passes.

real_checker_ports.reuse: src/asof/journal.py read_chain algorithm and src/asof/serde.py canonical/fingerprint/strict duplicate-key logic, adapted to captured bytes only
real_checker_ports.requirements: Exact canonical UTF8 JSONL framing and complete final newline; <=8MiB/2048 events; no duplicate keys/nonfinite/bool-as-counter; sequence starts0; previous digest and canonical event digest correct; source-bound reservation/creation/resume/terminal order; referenced report/raw records match. Check original deadline per bounded event; no incomplete-tail option for complete verification.

real_checker_ports.reuse: SDK structure/layout declarations and job_snapshot_problem semantics as source references, not callable live methods
real_checker_ports.requirements: Pure little-endian decode ACCOUNTING48 and PID_LIST136 raw hex, validate returned lengths/counts/flags and compare every serialized decoded field. Reconcile all raw snapshots with journal/report and source phases: empty0/0; live1/1 ownPID; finished1/0 empty, terminated0. Running allows only the source's consistent live-or-finished states. Queries are non-atomic; contradictory/transitional data is incomplete/failure, never normalized. Reconcile exact active1/memory256MiB policy, peak bounds, one known owned creation/resume/exit/reaping and independent EOF/capture byte hashes/truncation/cleanup outcomes. No live process or Job API.
real_checker_ports.scope: Retained source-bound observations only; no global process absence, universal containment or uninstrumented native/initializer activity claim.

real_checker_ports.reuse: recognition_validation_v3 exact/json_value/counter_frame and old decode_pack/validate_rows semantics are reusable references only for their exact old contract; recognition_module_policy_v1 remains phase-aware pure matching
real_checker_ports.requirements: Bind a separately frozen versioned profile decoder/strict validator/full negative observer and source bytes. Run the strict success gate unchanged; independently inspect all retained well-framed rows for negative coverage, caps, missingness and source binding without patching success predicates or treating observer counts as strict acceptance.
real_checker_ports.new_unicode_profile: Currently draft only:84 full-response cases, four stage/payload instances, complete bounded token IDs/lengths/piecehex ledger, whole-corpus class counts and deterministic de-duplicated selectors for width2/3/4/mixed. A new exact decoder/row schema/parser and oracle/source proofs must freeze before this binding is implementable. No old189/6 constants or old pack authority carry forward.
real_checker_ports.truth_limit: Pure piece concatenation/scalar/selector checks can validate reported source-bound data. They do not replay tokenization, authenticate model-to-token mappings, prove full-vocabulary masks or establish scientific/model quality.

sink_and_seal_DAG.old_sealer: Reference for immutable primary/late/after-seal veto precedence only. Do not call its rglob/file_pin/automatic-close machinery or inherit a profile-success status literal.
sink_and_seal_DAG.exclusive_namespace: One fixed new verifier cache subtree, no preexisting directory reuse. Before known ownership, no failure/seal/report writes are permitted.
sink_and_seal_DAG.write_ownership: Output handles also enter the owner registry before write/flush/close. Preserve partial short-write counts, unknown returns and one-attempt close states. No write retry after a failed/unreturned operation; successful partial writes continue only under the existing bounded byte/call policy.
order: Reserve directory plus journal and retain source-only invocation/origin witness before any original evidence read
Append bounded attempt/return events through required work stages; all source/evidence reads remain in one owner
After all work gates, write a nonfinal candidate; reserve finalization, close all originals once and persist independent cleanup outcomes without rewriting primary failures
Append the seal reservation before seal dispatch; flush/close the journal once and bind its exact acknowledged bytes/tip
Write/flush/close receipt binding candidate, cleanup, final journal and exact source/input digests
Write/flush/close a terminal seal binding the complete fixed output map excluding itself and potential later veto markers
Return a typed owner-bound terminal acknowledgment only after all required known output closes and the final original-clock check
sink_and_seal_DAG.candidate_and_seal: Always explicitly nonfinal until the returned final-clock acknowledgment; no serialized ready/passed record alone authorizes completion. No self-hash cycle or normal journal append after its sealed tip.
sink_and_seal_DAG.failure_markers: Immutable failure.json, late-failure.json and after-seal-failure.json when publication is possible; every marker and missing/failed seal/required return vetoes positive status. Preserve primary and later errors separately.
sink_and_seal_DAG.postdeadline: No positive evidence or new validation/original I/O after deadline. If a late seal return prevents safe file publication, retain an in-memory veto and nonzero/incomplete return; do not add another I/O budget to force a marker. A live sink must not turn the pure engine's best-effort failure callback into unbounded postdeadline file I/O.
sink_and_seal_DAG.caller_rule: Complete result requires exact returned acknowledgment, expected successful process exit and no veto. Missing/interrupted/unknown return is incomplete even if a candidate seal exists. Communication/formatting after the terminal result grants no new eligibility.

bounds_preserved_or_proposed.joint_event_reservation: 6*N+64+128 <=2048; three existing factory stages consume6 of the64 fixed events; account bootstrap adoption stages inside that same bound before opening originals
bounds_preserved_or_proposed.new_roster_rule: Count actual future static/dynamic/payload/owner/archive/bootstrap leaves and unique admitted ancestors before opening. If the exact graph or event/memory reservation does not fit, hold; no silent exclusion, count assumption or cap raise.
bounds_preserved_or_proposed.native_target_caps: All existing source/recognition per-API and aggregate call caps remain unchanged. New verifier file-call caps are separate and must be frozen/derived from the exact roster before implementation.

required_source_pure_vectors_before_live: First entry clock precedes delayed imports/source hashing/output setup; a >295s setup cannot be rescued by engine import or continuation
Same origin/nonce/deadlines survive source loader and owner handoff; numeric/serialized/foreign/double-use origins reject
Output reservation failure/unknown acknowledgment produces zero original reads and zero writes into an unowned namespace
Valid raw handle enters its reserved slot before injected identity/allocation/clock/log failure; invalid sentinel has no close; unreturned open remains unknown
Early source leases and bytes survive engine import failure and handoff; no second original hash pass or missing source gate
Defined ReadFile counts survive copy/digest/deadline failures; undefined/nonreturned counts never become zero or success
Close false/throw/late remains once-only, primary preserved; no implicit adapter close or repeated uncertain cleanup
Actual-format receipt/seal map/self-cycle/relative path/reparse/universe/failure-veto mutations reject without opening unknown files
Actual-format journal duplicate key/truncation/last-newline/chain/order/raw-record mutations reject under per-event clock checks
Raw ACCOUNTING/PID bytes versus decoded flags/length/PID/phase/peaks/EOF/exit/reaping claims mutated independently cannot pass
Strict success coverage and all-row negative observation remain distinct across missing/malformed/late rows
Future Unicode piece reconstruction/zero pieces/class counts/first-selector/population/de-dup/missingness fail closed against its own frozen wire, not the old profile
Short/unknown output write/flush/close/journal/seal and post-seal deadline yield incomplete with no serialized positive shortcut
Bounded complete positive and consistent-negative synthetic end-to-end fixtures reach every real checker; no stub checker is accepted as live qualification
review_and_activation_gates: Root and independent peer review this design before source/pure implementation
Freeze new Unicode corpus/contract/wire separately; design presently records only a future binding
Implement/review minimal bootstrap origin/handoff and file/sink interfaces with synthetic ports before any live adapter calls
Implement real byte-based archive/journal/raw-resource/profile ports with targeted false-positive tests and source-bound identities
Freeze exact acyclic source/authority/roles/output DAG/call budgets and all pure proofs
Independent exact source/proof review, then separate root permission for any bounded live file-only qualification
Any real profile or target execution requires its own later authorization; no original experiment retry follows
current_completion_claim: Design only. No adapter implementation, protocol creation, original rehash, live file qualification, scientific verification or repair of the previous timeout.
